title: One year later
description: Linking ideas: if, except, in order to, and also. Comparing Denmark and China, and looking back on a year of Chinese.

sentences.pinyin: Mǐgé, zhè yì nián nǐ de biànhuà hěn dà!
sentences.english: 米格, you've changed so much this year!

sentences.hanzi: 真的吗？我的中文还差得远呢。
sentences.pinyin: Zhēn de ma? Wǒ de Zhōngwén hái chà de yuǎn ne.
sentences.english: Really? My Chinese still has a long way to go.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ de Zhōngwén hái chà de yuǎn ne.
sentences.english: My Chinese still has a long way to go.

sentences.hanzi: 哪里！现在你几乎都听得懂了。
sentences.pinyin: Nǎlǐ! Xiànzài nǐ jīhū dōu tīng de dǒng le.
sentences.english: Not at all! Now you understand almost everything.

sentences.pinyin: Chúle lǎolao shuō de Běijīng huà!

sentences.pinyin: Xiànzài chà wǔ fēn bā diǎn.
sentences.english: It's five to eight.

sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ tīng bu dǒng, jiù wèn wǒ.

sentences.hanzi: 你真好。天冷了，注意身体！
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ zhēn hǎo. Tiān lěng le, zhùyì shēntǐ!

sentences.pinyin: Tiān lěng le, zhùyì shēntǐ!
sentences.english: It's getting cold, look after yourself!

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng zìjǐ qù mǎi dōngxi.
sentences.english: I want to go shopping by myself.

sentences.pinyin: Zhè shì nǐ zìjǐ zuò de ma?
sentences.english: Did you make this yourself?

sentences.pinyin: Tā hěn cōngming, érqiě hěn nǔlì.
sentences.english: She's clever, and hard-working too.

sentences.pinyin: Jīntiān bǐjiào lěng.
sentences.english: It's rather cold today.

sentences.pinyin: Nǐ bìxū duō chī diǎn!
sentences.english: You must eat more!

sentences.hanzi: 他送你礼物，表示他很喜欢你。
sentences.pinyin: Tā sòng nǐ lǐwù, biǎoshì tā hěn xǐhuan nǐ.
sentences.english: He gave you a present. That shows he really likes you.

sentences.pinyin: Bié dānxīn biéren zěnme xiǎng.
sentences.english: Don't worry about what other people think.

sentences.pinyin: Tā tūrán chūxiàn le!

sentences.pinyin: Nǐ de shēngyīn tài dī le, wǒ tīng bu dào.
sentences.english: You're speaking too quietly. I can't hear you.

sentences.pinyin: Lǎolao gāoxìng de xiào le.

sentences.pinyin: Gēnjù dìtú, fànguǎn jiù zài qiánmiàn.
sentences.english: According to the map, the restaurant is just ahead.

sentences.pinyin: Nǐmen shì shénme guānxi?

sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen de guānxi hěn hǎo.
sentences.english: We get on very well.

sentences.pinyin: Dānmài hé Zhōngguó yǒu hěn duō xiāngtóng de dìfang.

exchanges.context: Her mother praises your progress. Be modest.
Grandma reminds you to look after yourself in the cold.
A stranger asks about you and an old friend. Say you get on well.
On a bad phone line you can barely hear the caller.
You're her mother. 米格 jokes he can't follow Grandma's slang.

grammar.title: 为了: in order to
grammar.body: 为了 + goal, then what you do: 为了跟你们说话，我每天学习中文.

grammar.title: 如果…就…: if... then
grammar.body: 如果 + condition, 就 + result: 如果你听不懂，就问我. In speech 如果 is sometimes dropped.

grammar.title: 除了: except, besides
grammar.body: 除了 X means "except X" or "besides X". 除了姥姥说的北京话: except Grandma's Beijing slang.

grammar.title: Three kinds of de: 的, 得, 地
grammar.body: All are said de. 的 links to a noun (我的书). 得 says how well a verb is done (说得很好). 地 says how an action is done (高兴地笑了).

grammar.title: 差: short of
grammar.body: 差 means "short of": 差五分八点 (five to eight). 还差得远 (still far off) is the modest answer to praise.

dialogue.title: Listening challenge: One year later
dialogue.setting: A year after his first visit, 米格 chats with her mother in the kitchen.

questions.q: What has changed about 米格?
What can he still not follow?
